Suppose that $A = PDP^{-1}$ where $$ D = \left[\begin{array}{rr} 1 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 0 \\ \end{array}\right],\qquad P = \left[\begin{array}{rr} 1 \amp -2 \\ 2 \amp 1 \\ \end{array}\right] $$ .

Explain the geometric effect that $D$ has on vectors in $\real^2$.

Explain the geometric effect that $A$ has on vectors in $\real^2$.

What can you say about $A^2$ and other powers of $A$?

Is $A$ invertible?
